invariants: A lane writes only its private attempt root.
SEALED is written last and binds request, result, and inventory checksums.
The reducer reloads and validates sealed bytes instead of trusting the lane object.
The reducer rechecks lifecycle source, facts, prompt, candidate, and fence identity.
Only a reducer receipt can advance the durable lifecycle or compatibility manifest.
Reducer-owned manifest state cannot be overwritten by an unchanged lane retry.
Incomplete and corrupt attempts remain diagnostic input and cannot be promoted.
Full identities remain in request and receipt documents; compact aliases avoid Windows path overflow and are collision-checked.
